plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-effort-slider

[English](#english) · [中文](#中文)

A **Codex-style reasoning-effort slider** for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**: it replaces the composer's discrete effort picker with one continuous, **colour-shifting** track — blue at the cool end, violet in the middle, bright lavender at the top.

![preview](preview.png)

---

## English

### The colours

Dragging does not merely lengthen a bar; the fill **heats up** as the effort rises:

| Position | Fill's right end | Feel |
|---|---|---|
| low (≤ 1/3) | `#4D93F8` blue | cool |
| middle (1/3 – 2/3) | blue → `#9333EA` violet | warming |
| high (≥ 2/3) | violet → `#C084FC` lavender | hot |

- The fill always starts blue on the left and blends toward the current accent, producing one continuous gradient.
- A glossy **sheen** layer rides on top of the gradient.
- The track is a **10 px pill**; the knob is a **white circle** with a same-colour ring.
- Tick marks and the current-level label **tint with the same ramp** (blue → indigo → lavender).
- The top stop is deliberately a *bright* lavender rather than a deep purple: deep purple is nearly invisible against the dark composer panel.

The palette follows the colour scheme of OpenAI Codex's reasoning-effort slider (`#4d93f8` / `#9333ea` / `#c084fc`, mixing across thirds of the track). Colour values only — no Codex code is included.

### Interaction

- 1:1 pointer dragging; on release the knob snaps to the nearest level and saves.
- Keyboard: ← / → step one level, Home / End jump to the ends.
- The menu stays open so you can fine-tune; a failed save springs the knob back.
- Registered as a `priority: -1` shadow of `conversation.input.model`, so the stock model seat stays as a fallback.

### Install

```sh
# web surface
dsh plugin --profile web add github:SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-effort-slider

# desktop app
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-effort-slider
```

Or clone and install by path:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-effort-slider
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-effort-slider
```

**Restart DSH afterwards** (restart the app on desktop).

### Compatibility

Works on DSH `0.1.x` (web) and `0.2.1+` (desktop).

On 0.2.x, a traced service method rebinds `this.ctx` to the **caller**, and the `modelDirectories` resolver resolves `remote.session` through that context. Without declaring `remote` / `remote.session` in `inject`, the composer seat crashes with:

```
cannot get property "remote.session" without inject
slot entry crashed in 'conversation.input.model'
```

Both are declared here, and the registration uses the 0.2.x form (`ctx.slots.inject(...)` directly).

### Tests

```sh
npm install
npm test
```

Asserts the registration surface, the `remote.session` declaration, that the inject face resolves, that the component renders, and that **the three fill colours really progress with position** (`#4D93F8` → `#7063F1` → `#BF82FB`).

### License

GPL-3.0-or-later — see [LICENSE](LICENSE) for the full text. Third-party notes in [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md).

---

## 中文

### 配色

拖动时颜色会随档位**"升温"**，不是单纯的进度条变长：

| 位置 | 填充右端颜色 | 观感 |
|---|---|---|
| 低段（≤ 1/3） | `#4D93F8` 蓝 | 冷 |
| 中段（1/3 ~ 2/3） | 蓝 → `#9333EA` 紫罗兰 | 过渡 |
| 高段（≥ 2/3） | 紫罗兰 → `#C084FC` 亮紫 | 热 |

- 填充始终以蓝为左端、向当前档位颜色过渡，形成一条连续渐变；
- 渐变之上叠一层**高光 sheen**；
- 轨道是 **10px 药丸形**，滑块是**白色圆钮**并带同色描边；
- 刻度点与当前档位文字**同样跟色**（蓝 → 靛紫 → 亮紫）；
- 最高档刻意用**亮紫而非深紫**：深紫在深色面板上几乎看不见。

配色参考了 OpenAI Codex 推理强度滑条（`#4d93f8` / `#9333ea` / `#c084fc`，按轨道前中后三段混合），仅取色值，不含 Codex 代码。

### 交互

- 指针 1:1 跟手拖动；松手吸附到最近档位并保存；
- 键盘 ← / → 逐档，Home / End 跳到两端；
- 菜单保持打开便于连续微调；保存失败会回弹；
- 以 `priority: -1` 影子注册 `conversation.input.model`，原模型座位作为兜底。

### 安装

```sh
# Web 版
dsh plugin --profile web add github:SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-effort-slider

# 桌面应用版
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-effort-slider
```

或克隆后按路径安装：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/SailingBoat-ovo/dsh-effort-slider
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-effort-slider
```

**装完重启 DSH**（桌面版重启应用）。

### 兼容性

同时适配 DSH `0.1.x`（Web）与 `0.2.1+`（桌面版）。

在 0.2.x 上，traced 服务方法会把 `this.ctx` 重绑到**调用方**，而 `modelDirectories` 会经由该上下文解析 `remote.session`。若 `inject` 未声明 `remote` / `remote.session`，模型座位会直接崩溃：

```
cannot get property "remote.session" without inject
slot entry crashed in 'conversation.input.model'
```

本插件已声明这两项，并使用 0.2.x 写法（`ctx.slots.inject(...)` 直接注册）。

### 测试

```sh
npm install
npm test
```

覆盖注册面、`remote.session` 声明、注入面可解析、组件渲染，以及**三档填充颜色确实随位置递进**（`#4D93F8` → `#7063F1` → `#BF82FB`）。

### 许可

GPL-3.0-or-later，完整文本见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)；第三方说明见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)。

plugins.description: Portable project memory for coding agents. Standalone runtime, observable records, code fingerprints, and Claude Code/Codex/DeepSeek Harness adapters.
plugins.readme_text:
# Remvu

[![Tests](https://github.com/caotaiyi/remvu/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/caotaiyi/remvu/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Standalone and DSH](https://github.com/caotaiyi/remvu/actions/workflows/standalone.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/caotaiyi/remvu/actions/workflows/standalone.yml)

Save before Claude Code hits its limit. Continue in Codex with the project background intact.

Remvu keeps goals, constraints, rejected approaches, unfinished work and check evidence alongside your project. The complete standalone engine bundles its runtime: **users do not install Python**. Opt-in observable recording, code fingerprints, concurrent updates, recovery and private sharing boundaries remain part of the engine.

[中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Install](docs/quickstart.md) · [DeepSeek Harness plugin](adapters/dsh/README.md) · [Evidence and limits](docs/standalone.md)

Fresh installations create no hooks. Recording is a separate choice; fingerprints, CAS protection and recovery stay available in manual mode. Resume reads a short preview; details are fetched only when needed.

## Try the complete app

> Install the complete Remvu standalone candidate from https://github.com/caotaiyi/remvu for my OS and architecture. Verify its checksum, extract the entire application folder, then run its install command for this project. Preserve existing settings and memory. Install save/resume without hooks. Enable recording only if I ask; explain any required client trust once. Do not install a system Python or substitute the notes-only fallback.

The v0.3.0-beta.3 application is a test candidate. CI produces platform archives; a production release and the full native-client support matrix remain gated on actual acceptance. See [the build and installation guide](docs/standalone.md) for available artifacts, verification and exact steps. Git is still required. macOS distribution signing/notarization is not configured.

| Everyday action | Claude Code | Codex |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Save a private handoff | `/remvu save` | `$remvu save` |
| Continue in a new session | `/remvu resume` | `$remvu resume` |

`save` asks the current agent to consolidate reviewed evidence and exports `.remvu/handoff/REMVU.md`. A direct program invocation without a proposal exports existing state and leaves pending evidence pending. It never uploads or commits. `resume` checks the saved code state before continuing. The receiver can also read the handoff alongside the code without installing Remvu.

Save while the original agent can still respond. Automatic logs retain observations; they cannot recover an exhausted agent's unwritten understanding. Stop hooks do not block completion or force another model turn.

## A handoff in 30 seconds

1. In Claude Code, ask `/remvu save`.
2. Open the project in Codex and ask `$remvu resume`.
3. Review the next step and any stale checks, pending evidence or conflicts, then continue.

This describes the workflow, not a measured completion-time guarantee. [Earlier real handoff trials](docs/validation-report.md) and the [10-task notes-only comparison](docs/product-validation.md) are published with their limits. The latter found no first-pass accuracy advantage over ordinary HANDOFF notes; it does not measure the new standalone app or prove token savings.

## DeepSeek Harness

The `dsh-remvu` bundle adds five native tools and observable event recording to DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2**. It uses the same standalone engine and `.remvu/` state. The JavaScript package needs no compilation or install-time build script. [Install the plugin](adapters/dsh/README.md).

The plugin was installed through the official `dsh plugin add` flow and loaded in a real isolated SDK profile without a model request. Model-driven handoff and GUI acceptance are separate pending checks. Local projects only; it does not claim cloud or remote-filesystem support.

## What stays in memory

Claims distinguish `user_confirmed`, `observed`, `inferred` and `unverified`. Rejected decisions and superseded history survive. Check results retain the code fingerprint they actually tested; later edits make those checks historical. Concurrent proposals cannot silently overwrite newer memory.

Private memory and detailed evidence stay in ignored `.remvu/`. Public `REMVU.md` is generated only on an explicit share request, with public inline evidence and patch review. Hidden reasoning, credentials and unrelated conversations are excluded. `doctor`, `repair`, upgrades, rollback and uninstall remain available when needed; uninstall retains private memory.

## For multi-model platforms and API relay services

“换模型、换客户端，把项目背景一起带走。” A platform that can observe local project changes and tool outcomes can embed the memory engine or build an adapter. Pure API forwarding has no complete view of the project and cannot promise full operation records. The DSH adapter is a concrete local-host integration; no generic relay integration or measured savings percentage is claimed.

## Other paths and contributors

A [notes-only fallback](skills/remvu/assets/markdown-skill.md) remains available for users who deliberately want file-tool save/resume without recording or structured validation. Source developers can still run the standard-library Python engine. Neither path replaces the complete standalone app.

[Open format](spec/README.md) · [Compatibility](docs/compatibility.md) · [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [License](LICENSE). Existing `remvu/1` documents and legacy evidence import remain supported.

plugins.description: 把 DeepSeek 网页版聊天装进 DSH 桌面版面板：侧栏入口 + 工具栏 + 本地登录快照。 | Embed the DeepSeek web chat in a DSH Desktop main panel.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-dschat

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-dschat.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-dschat)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-dschat.svg)](https://github.com/Jakcet/dsh-dschat/blob/main/LICENSE)

把 DeepSeek 网页版聊天（[chat.deepseek.com](https://chat.deepseek.com/)）装进 **DSH 桌面版**的面板里。

侧栏会多一个「DeepSeek 网页版」图标，点开就是一个主面板，里面用 Electron `<webview>` 原样载入网页版，工具栏可以后退、前进、刷新、回首页、在系统浏览器打开。登录在 DeepSeek 自己的页面上完成，插件不接触你的密码。

> 这个面板需要 `globalThis.dshDesktop.browser`，它只由 DSH 桌面版的 preload 暴露；Web 版只会显示一行提示。

## 功能

- **侧栏入口 + 主面板**：keyed panel，图标是蓝色鲸鱼气泡。
- **工具栏**：后退、前进、刷新、回 DeepSeek 首页、当前地址、在系统浏览器中打开。
- **原样加载** `https://chat.deepseek.com/`，不改页面、不注入脚本（只在你登录后读一次 `localStorage` 做快照）。
- **登录快照**：DSH 侧栏浏览器的 partition 是进程内内存分区，应用重启就丢 cookie。登录后插件把页面 `localStorage` 里登录相关的键备份到 `~/.dsh/dsh-dschat/storage.json`（权限 `0600`），下次载入时先回填、再刷新页面。
  能不能因此完全跳过登录页，取决于网页版把会话放在哪里：`httpOnly` cookie 不在快照范围内。

## 安装

在 DSH 插件市场里搜索 `dsh-dschat` 安装，或手动作为 bundle 装进你的 DSH profile：

```sh
npm install dsh-dschat
```

## 要求

- **DSH 桌面版**（依赖 preload 暴露的 `globalThis.dshDesktop.browser`）。
- DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`。

## 它是怎么工作的

1. 主面板挂载时，client 半部向 DSH 桌面版的 preload 桥申请一个 guest：`globalThis.dshDesktop.browser.acquire(workspace)`。
2. 拿到 `{ lease, partition }` 后创建 `<webview>`，`name` 填 lease、`partition` 填 partition、`src` 填 `about:blank#<lease>`；DSH 主进程会在 `will-attach-webview` 里校验 lease 和 partition，通过后才真正挂载。
3. pages 加载完成（`dom-ready`）后 `loadURL('https://chat.deepseek.com/')`。
4. 登录态变化后，把 `localStorage` 里键名匹配 `token/user/auth/session/login` 的字符串值 POST 给插件的 host 路由，写到本地快照文件；下次打开时先回填再刷新。
5. 面板卸载时 `bridge.release(lease)` 释放 guest。

因为走的是和内置侧栏浏览器同一套 lease 校验、sandbox 与导航策略，插件本身拿不到 Electron/Node 权限。

## 已知限制（来自 DSH 宿主策略，插件绕不过去）

- guest 内发起的**下载会被取消**。
- 通知、麦克风、剪贴板等**权限请求一律拒绝**。
- 窗口打开请求会转成同面板内导航。
- 浏览器 partition 每次启动重建，用公开 API 做不到「完全零登录」重启。
- 只有桌面版可用，Web 版不工作。

## 隐私

插件不代理、不抓取、不转发任何内容，只渲染官方页面并保留一份本地快照。快照里可能有登录相关数据的明文，请当作 cookie 文件对待，不要分享；删掉 `~/.dsh/dsh-dschat/storage.json` 即可清除快照。

## 文件

- `index.js` — host 半部：快照与日志的 HTTP 路由，以及一次性的客户端模块清单缓存刷新。
- `client.js` — client 半部：侧栏图标、主面板、webview 生命周期、工具栏。
- `cordis.patch.yml` — bundle patch。
- `icon.svg` — 插件图标。

## License

MIT

---

# English

Embed the DeepSeek web chat (`chat.deepseek.com`) in a **DSH Desktop** main panel.

A sidebar entry opens a keyed main panel that hosts the real DeepSeek web app inside an
Electron `<webview>` guest, requested from the DSH desktop preload bridge
(`globalThis.dshDesktop.browser.acquire`) so it goes through the same main-process lease
check, sandbox flags and navigation policy as the built-in sidebar browser.

## What it does

- Adds a **DeepSeek Web** entry to the sidebar icon list and a main panel.
- Toolbar: back, forward, reload, home, current URL, open in system browser.
- Loads `https://chat.deepseek.com/` unmodified. Sign-in happens on DeepSeek's own page;
  the plugin never sees or stores your password.
- **Login snapshot.** DSH's sidebar-browser partition is a process-local in-memory
  partition, so cookies are gone after an app restart. After you sign in, the plugin copies
  login-related `localStorage` keys to `~/.dsh/dsh-dschat/storage.json` (mode `0600`) and
  restores them on the next load before reloading the page. Whether that is enough to skip
  the sign-in screen depends on where DeepSeek keeps the session: `httpOnly` cookies are
  not part of the snapshot.

## Install

Install it from the DSH plugin market (search for `dsh-dschat`), or add this package as a
bundle to your DSH profile:

```sh
npm install dsh-dschat
```

## Requirements

- **DSH Desktop.** The panel needs `globalThis.dshDesktop.browser`, which only the desktop
  preload exposes. In the web build the panel shows a notice and does nothing.
- DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.2`.

## Known limits (enforced by the DSH host, not by this plugin)

- Downloads started inside the guest are cancelled.
- Permission requests (notifications, microphone, clipboard) are denied.
- Window-open requests are turned into navigation in the same panel.
- The browser partition is recreated on every app start, so a fully zero-login restart is
  not possible with the public host API.

## Privacy

The plugin does not proxy, scrape or forward anything. It renders the official page and
keeps one local snapshot file. That file can contain login-related values in plain text;
treat it like a cookie jar and do not share it. Delete it to forget the snapshot.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: OpenAI-compatible local proxy exposing JoyCode (JD Cloud JoyCoder) credits, plus a DSH model-provider plugin
plugins.readme_text:
# joycode-proxy

> 📘 English documentation: [README.en.md](./README.en.md)

把 **JoyCode（京东云 JoyCoder 积分）** 反代成一个 OpenAI 兼容的 HTTP 服务，再通过一个 DSH provider 插件把它的积分池接进 DSH，当作 agent 的模型后端。整体思路与 `qoder-proxy` / `dsh-llm-qoder` 完全一致，只是后端换成了 JoyCode 的「color gateway」协议。

## 架构

```
DSH agent
  └─ ctx.llm.registerAdapter(["joycode"], adapter)   ← dsh-llm-joycode 插件
       └─ PiAiAdapter → openAICompletionsApi(baseUrl=本地 shim)
            └─ POST http://127.0.0.1:8318/v1/chat/completions
                 └─ joycode-proxy (server.mjs)
                      └─ POST https://api-ai.jd.com/api?appid=joycode_ide&functionId=chat_completions&t=...&sign=...
                           (HMAC-SHA256 签名 + ptKey 头)
                           └─ JoyCode 后端（同一账号的积分计费）
```

## 端点

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| GET  | `/v1/models` | 返回 JoyCode 后端模型列表 |
| POST | `/v1/chat/completions` | OpenAI 兼容，支持 `stream: true/false` |
| GET  | `/health` | 探活 + 配置自检 |

## 为什么用「color gateway」而不是逆向

JoyCode IDE 的请求签名与鉴权都在它自带的 `extension.js` 里明文实现，核心只有三样东西：

1. **网关地址**：`https://api-ai.jd.com/api`（登录态里的 `colorBaseUrl`）。
2. **鉴权头**：`ptKey`（登录态里的 `ptKey`，即京东云账号票据）+ 可选 `loginType`/`tenant`。
3. **签名**：对 `{appid, functionId, t}` 排序后取非空值 `&` 拼接，用 HMAC-SHA256 + IDE 内置签名密钥算 hex，作为 `sign` 查询参数。

因此不需要逆向任何加密/WASM，直接把这段签名逻辑复刻成 `server.mjs` 里的 `signQuery()` / `gatewayUrl()` 即可。

> **关于那个签名密钥**：它是 IDE 客户端内置的**公开协议常量**，随 IDE 分发给每个用户，不是账号凭据——单独拿到它无法发起任何有效请求。真正的凭据是 `ptKey`，**只从环境变量读、永不入库**。若上游轮换密钥，重新从 `extension.js` 提取，或用 `JOYCODE_SIGN_KEY` 覆盖。

## 配置（环境变量）

| 变量 | 必需 | 默认 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|------|
| `JOYCODE_PT_KEY` | ✅ | 空 | 账号票据（登录态 `jdhLoginInfo.ptKey`） |
| `JOYCODE_TENANT` | ⭕ | 空 | 租户 ID（登录态 `tenant`） |
| `JOYCODE_COLOR_BASE_URL` | ⭕ | `https://api-ai.jd.com` | 网关 origin（登录态 `colorBaseUrl`） |
| `JOYCODE_MASTER_BASE_URL` | ⭕ | 空 | 直连 origin（登录态 `masterBaseUrl`），网关不可用时兜底 |
| `JOYCODE_LOGIN_TYPE` | ⭕ | `PIN_JD_CLOUD` | 登录类型 |
| `JOYCODE_SIGN_KEY` | ⭕ | 内置常量 | 覆盖签名密钥（上游轮换时用） |
| `JOYCODE_PROXY_PORT` | ⭕ | `8318` | 本地监听端口 |
| `JOYCODE_PROXY_HOST` | ⭕ | `127.0.0.1` | 监听地址 |
| `JOYCODE_PROXY_MODEL` | ⭕ | `JoyAI-Code-1.6` | 缺省模型 |
| `JOYCODE_PROXY_API_KEY` | ⭕ | 空 | 设置后要求 `Authorization: Bearer <key>` |

> **怎么拿到自己的凭据**：JoyCode IDE 的登录态存在一个 SQLite 库里
> （Windows `%APPDATA%\JoyCode\User\globalStorage\state.vscdb`；
> macOS `~/Library/Application Support/JoyCode/User/globalStorage/state.vscdb`；
> Linux `~/.config/JoyCode/User/globalStorage/state.vscdb`）。
> 读 `ItemTable` 表里 key 为 `JoyCoder.IDE` 的那一行，其 JSON 的
> `joyCoderUser` 里就有 `ptKey` / `colorBaseUrl` / `masterBaseUrl` / `tenant`。
> 把这些填进 `.env`（见 `.env.example`）。**`.env` 已在 `.gitignore` 里，绝不要提交。**
>
> 不想手动抠？跑 `npm run setup`，它会自动从本机 IDE 登录态读出凭据写进 `.env`。

## 模型列表（后端实时返回）

- `JoyAI-Code-1.6`
- `GLM-5.3-agent`（GLM-5.3）
- `Kimi-K2.6-agent`（Kimi-K2.6，多模态）
- `MiniMax-M3-agent`（MiniMax-M3，多模态）
- `Doubao-Seed-2.0-pro-agent`（Doubao-Seed-2.0-pro，多模态）

## 启动

```powershell
$env:JOYCODE_PT_KEY = "<ptKey>"
node server.mjs
```

验证：

```powershell
curl.exe -s http://127.0.0.1:8318/v1/models
curl.exe -s http://127.0.0.1:8318/v1/chat/completions `
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" `
  -d '{\"model\":\"JoyAI-Code-1.6\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"reply exactly PONG\"}]}'
```

## 快速开始

```bash
git clone <this-repo> && cd joycode-proxy
npm run setup             # 自动从本机 JoyCode IDE 登录态读出 ptKey / tenant 写进 .env
npm start
```

> 没有装 JoyCode IDE？手动也行：
> ```bash
> cp .env.example .env      # 然后填入你自己的 ptKey / tenant
> npm start
> ```

验证：

```bash
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8318/v1/models
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8318/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"JoyAI-Code-1.6","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"reply exactly PONG"}]}'
```

> 零运行时依赖：只用 Node 内置的 `node:http` / `node:crypto`，`npm install` 不是必需的。

## 接 DSH

一条命令即可完成挂载（自动建 junction + 追加 patch 条目，幂等）：

```bash
npm run install:dsh          # 等价于 node install-dsh-plugin.mjs
# 可选：指定 profile / DSH_HOME
DSH_PROFILE=web DSH_HOME=/path/to/.dsh node install-dsh-plugin.mjs
```

手动方式：

1. 把 `dsh-plugin/` 挂进你的 DSH profile（例如用 junction / symlink 放到
   `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-llm-joycode`，或直接 `dsh plugin add` 该目录）。
2. 在 `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 末尾追加：

   ```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: llm-joycode
         name: dsh-llm-joycode
   ```

3. 重启 DSH，模型选择器里应出现 `joycode` provider（5 个模型）。

## 已知限制

- **无状态**：把 OpenAI messages 拍平成单个 prompt，不保留跨请求会话（和 qoder-proxy 一致）。
- **不支持 function calling / tools**：JoyCode 网关的 chat completions 走纯文本路径。
- **单账号串行**：凭据来自一个登录态，多并发请求共享同一账号的积分。
- **签名密钥可能轮换**：密钥是 IDE 内置常量，上游更换后需重新提取，或用 `JOYCODE_SIGN_KEY` 覆盖。

## 免责声明

本项目仅用于在你自己的账号下、于本机把已有的 JoyCode 积分接到其它客户端，
便于个人开发使用。请自行确认你的用法符合服务商条款。作者不对账号封禁、
额度损失或任何间接损害负责。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH plugin orchestration and workspace-isolation manager: plugin scanning, per-workspace isolated instances, and a standalone rescue entry.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workspace-orchestrator

**按工作区隔离插件、诊断冲突、并在 DSH 崩溃时自救。**

DSH 插件编排与工作区隔离管理器：插件清单、冲突扫描、按工作区禁用插件（黑名单）、
独立的多开隔离实例，以及一个完全不依赖 DSH 进程的急救工具。

## 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-workspace-orchestrator
```

装完**托盘彻底退出 DSH 再启动**（不是关窗口）。

## 三个核心能力

### 1. 工作区插件黑名单（设置 → 工作区编排）

插件默认全开——原生面板怎么开就怎么来。这个面板只负责**局部禁用**：

- 顶部下拉框自动读取 DSH 左侧栏的工作区列表
- 下方列出所有第三方插件，**默认全部打勾**
- **取消勾选 = 在这个工作区禁用该插件**
- 切换工作区，勾选状态随之切换

写入 `$DSH_HOME/workspace-orchestrator/single-mode.json`：

```json
{ "version": 2, "workspaces": { "D:/my-project": { "disabledPlugins": ["dsh-novel-writer"] } } }
```

真正生效在**新建会话**时：进入某工作区，黑名单里的插件被卸载，其余恢复。
离开该工作区会自动还原。

> 带界面的双端插件（如 `dsh-webds-bridge`）后端被卸载后，**页面上的入口要刷新
> （`Ctrl+Shift+R`）才消失**——client 代码已经加载进浏览器了，后端管不到。

### 2. 隔离实例（多开）

面板里的「在此工作区开启隔离实例」，或对 Agent 说「在 `D:\code` 开一个隔离实例」。
独立 profile、独立会话与存储、OS 分配的端口。同样遵守该工作区的黑名单。

### 3. 急救工具

DSH 起不来时**不依赖 DSH**：

```bat
bin\rescue.bat --web        :: 打开独立急救网页面板（127.0.0.1:8765）
bin\rescue.bat desktop --disable <插件id>   :: 命令行禁用坏插件
```

急救面板可以列出插件、把插件**可逆地**移出 `node_modules` 并写入 `disabled: true`，
也支持 bundle 插件（无文件夹可移时改为改配置）。所有改动先备份，可一键恢复。

## Agent 工具

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `scan_plugins` | 列出当前 profile 的第三方插件 |
| `scan_conflicts` | 静态冲突扫描（重复 id / 重复包 / 重复 service / 循环依赖 / 缺依赖） |
| `manage_workspace_scope` | 读写工作区黑名单 |
| `launch/list/stop_workspace_instance` | 隔离实例的生死管理 |
| `debug_single_mode` | 诊断黑名单：报告每行的 `fiber` 是 ACTIVE 还是已卸载 |

直接说「调用 debug_single_mode」即可，它会给出结论，例如
「dsh-webds-bridge：已禁用，fiber 已卸载 —— 单开模式工作正常」。

## 排障

**插件禁用了还在跑？** 调用 `debug_single_mode` 看 `fiber` 列：

- `NONE` = 后端已卸载，你看到的是前端残留 → 刷新页面
- `ACTIVE` = 没禁用成功 → 看下面的调试日志

**开调试日志**（默认关闭）：

```powershell
# 方式一：环境变量后重启
setx DSH_ORCH_DEBUG 1

# 方式二：运行时开启（立即生效）
curl.exe -X POST -H "content-type: application/json" -d "{\"enabled\":true}" `
  "http://127.0.0.1:<端口>/workspace-orchestrator/api/scope/debug"
```

日志写入 `$DSH_HOME/workspace-orchestrator/debug.log`，含实际 cwd、`pathKey`、
匹配到的黑名单、每行的 `fiber` 前后状态。

## 离线自测

```powershell
node lib/orchestrator-core/verify-context-access.mjs
node lib/orchestrator-core/verify-rescue-web.mjs  --home D:\tmp\dsh-test
node lib/orchestrator-core/verify-scope-rpc.mjs   --home D:\tmp\dsh-test
node lib/orchestrator-core/verify-blacklist.mjs   --home D:\tmp\dsh-test
```

共 158 项检查，**拒绝在真实 `~/.dsh` 上运行**。

## 兼容性

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| DSH 运行时 | `0.2.1-rc.2`（本版本实测） |
| Node | `>= 22.19.0` |
| 前端 | DSH Web / 桌面端共用同一套设置面板 |
| 平台 | Windows 优先（路径规范化、急救 `.bat`）；其余平台未实测 |

## 设计约束

- **零第三方依赖，零 `@deepseek-ai/*` import**——框架能力只通过 `ctx` 获取
- **`apply()` 永不抛错**：任何失败都记录并降级，插件不会是 profile 启动失败的原因
- **绝不写回 profile patch**（除急救工具的显式动作）：黑名单只改内存与自己的映射文件

## What exists today

| Piece | State |
|---|---|
| Bundle patch `cordis.patch.yml` inserting loader row `dsh-workspace-orchestrator` | done |
| `apply(ctx)` — registers seven tools, zero throwing IO, never fails a boot | done |
| `scan_plugins` — third-party plugin inventory **+ live isolated-instance summary** | done |
| `launch_workspace_instance` — one-shot profile, isolated sessions/storages, OS-assigned port | done |
| `list_workspace_instances` — registry + process/port liveness | done |
| `stop_workspace_instance` — by pid / profile name / workspace path | done |
| `lib/orchestrator-core/` — profile & patch orchestration, instance registry, rescue mode | done |
| `bin/rescue.mjs` + `bin/rescue.bat` — standalone rescue (no DSH process needed) | done |
| `bin/rescue.mjs --web` — standalone rescue **web panel** with reversible disable/restore | done |
| Bundle-level rescue (`dsh.profile.bundles`): 仅禁用 / 彻底移除 / 恢复 | done |
| Workspace blacklist (settings panel + `manage_workspace_scope`) | done |
| Conflict scan (`lib/conflict-scan.mjs`, `scan_conflicts` tool + settings panel) | done |
| `debug_single_mode` — live fiber state diagnosis | done |
| Version rollback | **not yet** |

Everything instance-related lives in `lib/orchestrator-core/`; the tools are thin bridges that
translate arguments and render results, so there is exactly one implementation of the behaviour.

## Compatibility

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| DSH runtime verified against | `0.2.0-rc.2` (desktop app build `04f392c9ddd144fa426da2045178797da6db6c11`) |
| Electron / Node host | Electron `44.0.0`, Node `24.18.1` |
| `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | `4.0.4` |
| Declared in `package.json` | `dsh.compatibleRuntime: "0.2.0-rc.2"` |

## Engineering contract

- **No `@deepseek-ai/*` import.** Framework capabilities are reached through `ctx`
  (`ctx.tools`, `ctx.logger`). The tool is registered as a plain definition object, so
  `defineTool` is not needed; `lib/patch-yaml.js` and `lib/profile.js` are dependency-free
  and import only `node:` builtins.
- **`apply(ctx)` never throws and performs no IO.** It registers one tool and returns. Every
  failure path logs and degrades. Scanning happens inside `execute`.
- **No HTTP routes.** When one is added it will use the `/plugin-orchestrator/` prefix and
  degrade on conflict.
- **Unique entry id.** `dsh-workspace-orchestrator`; the tool name `scan_plugins` is
  likewise unique (the registry rejects duplicates, which is verified).
- **Read-only.** Stage 1 writes nothing anywhere.

## `scan_plugins`

Reads, in order:

1. `<profile>/package.json` → `dsh.profile.bundles` (the ordered bundle selection) and
   `dependencies` (what is actually installed).
2. `<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` → the user's patch layer: `insert` rows add loader entries,
   id-targeted rows override or disable them.
3. `ctx.get('pluginManager')` → optional. When the official manager service is mounted it
   supplies the runtime version and per-bundle load state. Its absence degrades fields to
   `null`; it never errors.

Returns, per third-party plugin: loader-entry `id`, package `name`, `version`, effective
`enabled`, and the `source` row that produced it (`bundle` / `patch-insert` / `dependency` /
`patch-override`). Bundles under `@deepseek-ai/*` are filtered out and only counted.

### The profile directory

Finding the *active* profile from inside the host process is the subtle part. `DSH_PROFILE_DIR`
and `DSH_PROFILE` are injected into **tool subprocess** environments and may be absent in the
host, so they are only the first guess. Candidates are tried in order
(`env:DSH_PROFILE_DIR` → the launcher's own `--profile` / positional argv → `hmr.baseDir` →`env:DSH_PROFILE` → walk-up from this module) and each is **validated structurally**: a real
profile directory has a `package.json` with a `dsh.profile` field. An unresolved profile is
reported as such rather than guessed.

## Installing

The Desktop profile is owned by the Electron application, so the CLI refuses to boot or
`--dump-config` it; plugin installation, however, is supported:

```
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-workspace-orchestrator
```

For any other profile, list the package in `dsh.profile.bundles` (or load
`cordis.patch.yml` as a `--patch` overlay):

```
dsh --profile <name> --patch <this-dir>/cordis.patch.yml
```

## Layout

```
index.js              apply(ctx), the scan_plugins definition, and its renderer
lib/profile.js        profile-directory discovery and structural validation
lib/patch-yaml.js     dependency-free reader for cordis.patch.yml
lib/scan.js           the inventory: sources, resolution, merge, report
cordis.patch.yml      bundle patch inserting the loader row
```

## Known limitation

`lib/patch-yaml.js` is not a general YAML parser. It reads exactly the patch layer's shape and
skips `config:` blocks wholesale (a row's config is arbitrary deployment data — the desktop
profile's `llm-pi-ai` row holds a ~230-line nested provider map). Flow collections, block
scalars, anchors/aliases and multi-document files are reported as diagnostics rather than
silently misread.

## 六个工具与极简用法

| Tool | 一句话 | 自然语言示例 |
|---|---|---|
| `scan_plugins` | 列出当前 profile 的第三方插件 + 已开实例 | 「看看我现在装了哪些第三方插件？」 |
| `scan_conflicts` | 静态冲突扫描（重复 id / 重复包 / 重复 service / 环 / 缺依赖） | 「扫一下当前 profile 有没有插件冲突。」 |
| `manage_workspace_scope` | 读写「工作区 → 禁用黑名单」 | 「在 `D:\novels` 禁用 `dsh-novel-writer`。」 |
| `launch_workspace_instance` | 为工作区拉起隔离实例，返回 URL | 「在 `D:\code` 开一个隔离实例。」 |
| `list_workspace_instances` | 列出本管理器拉起的实例并探活 | 「现在开着几个隔

plugins.description: Aggregate DSH plugin catalogs into a plugin-market index format 1 document for the DeepSeek Harness Discover tab
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-discover-index

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Aggregates the live [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/) catalog into
**plugin market index format 1** — the JSON document the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
(DSH) Discover tab reads.

Published index: <https://hytime.github.io/dsh-discover-index/index.json>

> [!NOTE]
> **Requires a recent DSH, and it is used as a custom market.**
> This index is consumed by the experimental **Custom plugin markets** feature, not by
> DSH core. That feature first shipped in **DSH 0.2.1-alpha.4** (2026-10-15) and is
> carried by every 0.2.1 build since; an older DSH has no Discover tab and no way to add
> an index source. It is still marked experimental upstream, so it is off by default and
> you switch it on yourself — see [Using it in DSH Discover](#using-it-in-dsh-discover).
>
> Nothing here patches or extends DSH: this repository only publishes a JSON file, and
> DSH reads it once you point the feature at that URL.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **This project is a conversion and aggregation source, not a security review.**
> Every entry in the index is third-party data republished from upstream. Nothing here
> audits, sandboxes, or endorses the plugins it lists. Installing a DSH plugin runs
> third-party code inside your harness; review the plugin's source before you install it.

## Status

Published and automated. The index URL above serves a live document, rebuilt daily by
[`build.yml`](.github/workflows/build.yml) and deployed only after the real
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index` validator accepts it.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| TypeScript | compiles clean |
| Tests | Pass offline against fixtures recorded from the live catalog — `pnpm test` |
| Published index | Format 1, accepted by the real validator, rebuilt daily |
| Automation | daily cron, plus `workflow_dispatch` for a manual rebuild |

The exact plugin count is deliberately not quoted here: the pipeline reads the live
catalog, so it moves by a few entries between runs as upstream gains, loses, and re-pins
repositories. Query the index, or read the run summary in Actions, for today's number.
See [Running locally](#running-locally) to build it yourself.

## Run your own market

This repository is a template. Fork it, point it at a catalog, and it publishes your own
market at your own GitHub Pages URL, rebuilt daily — no server, and nothing hardcoded to
this account. **[Publishing your own plugin market →](FORKING.md)**

## What it produces

`dist/site/index.json` — a single format-1 document, published at
<https://hytime.github.io/dsh-discover-index/index.json>. Additional **profiles** declared
in `config/config.yml` each produce their own document (for example a star-floor subset
published as its own market), and each is validated independently in CI.

Alongside it: **`stats.html`**, a statistics page generated from the same document.

> `dist/site/` is what gets published; `dist/` also holds the compiled JavaScript, which
> is not. The Pages artifact is the `dist/site/` directory alone, so the build output is
> not served as web content.

### What the statistics page shows

<https://hytime.github.io/dsh-discover-index/stats.html>

The market index answers "which plugins exist". The statistics page answers the different
question a visitor deciding whether to add this market actually has: how much of it is
measured, and how much of it is trustworthy. It shows:

- **Coverage**, each figure against its own denominator — how many entries carry a star
  count, a download count, a version history, an `engines.dsh` range, a category, a label,
  or a risk finding. A single "coverage %" would be a fabricated number here: stars are
  known for one subset of plugins and DSH ranges for a different one, and dividing both by
  the same total would invent a fact nobody measured.
- **Distributions** — versions per plugin, plugins per category, plugins per label.
- **Who uses this index** — repositories that mention or consume it, graded by evidence:
  *reads the JSON* (the published index URL appears there), *mentions only* (just the name
  appears), or a fork, which can publish a copy of its own. The tiers are never summed into
  one number, because a curated list linking to this repository does not consume the market.

  Two honest limits are stated on the page rather than left implied. GitHub Pages keeps no
  access log, so how many clients actually loaded the index is recorded nowhere — usage
  leaves no public trace. And GitHub's code search does not index every repository or every
  recent change, so the reference figures are floors, not totals.

Everything is computed at build time from the document that was just validated, so the page
cannot describe a market that differs from the published one, and the numbers are in the
HTML rather than behind a script. The page loads **no third-party script**; the only remote
hosts it references are this project's own.

### What the market declares

Format 1 lets a market publish its own curated vocabulary, and Discover renders all of
it. This market uses each axis:

| Axis | What is declared | What it gives you in Discover |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `metadata.categories` | Upstream's 23 categories, translated | The category pills above the list |
| `metadata.labels` | Permission capabilities, risk findings, popularity buckets | The **Labels** filter menu and the tags on each card |
| `metadata.sortKeys` | `stars`, `downloads`, `added` | **Sort** menu entries, each opening descending |
| `metadata.keywords` | Runtime identity, category, and capability words | Free-text search recall |

**Labels** are the most useful of the four, because they answer questions the upstream
catalog cannot. They come from three places:

- **Capabilities** — upstream's trust scan reports what each plugin's code can reach:
  `fs-read`, `fs-write`, `network`, `shell`, `env`, `credentials`, `llm`,
  `host-runtime`, `dynamic-code`, `subagent`. Filtering for `shell` finds every plugin
  that can run commands on your machine.
- **Risk findings**, normalised into five classes rather than the 86 raw sentences
  upstream publishes (most name a single domain or IP): `risk:credentials-and-network`
  (476 entries), `risk:plaintext-http` (97), `risk:literal-ip` (47),
  `risk:install-time-code` (22), and `risk:dynamic-code`.
- **Popularity buckets** — `stars:1k+` / `100+` / `10+` / `1+` / `0` and
  `downloads:10k+` / `1k+` / `100+` / `1+` / `0`.

Popularity is bucketed rather than exact, and that is a format constraint: a label id is
declared once and *referenced* by plugins, so there is no per-plugin label value. Exact
values would need 235 labels for stars and 1,690 for downloads, which turns the filter
menu into an unusable list. The exact numbers are still there where they matter — they
are the `stars` and `downloads` sort keys, and DSH hands them to the model through its
`plugin_market` tool.

### Sources

| What | Where |
| --- | --- |
| Upstream catalog (the data) | <https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/plugins.json> · [awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) |
| Version history (npm) | <https://registry.npmjs.org/> — one document per npm package |
| This converter (the code) | <https://github.com/hytime/dsh-discover-index> |
| Published index (what DSH reads) | <https://hytime.github.io/dsh-discover-index/index.json> |

The index is a **conversion** of the upstream list, not an independent registry. Upstream
curates and hosts the catalog; this repository only converts it to format 1, checks it
against the real validator, and republishes it on a daily schedule. A bad entry should be
reported upstream; a bad *conversion* of a good entry belongs here.

### Version history

Upstream names exactly one version per entry. DSH's plugin page lists every version it can
install and refuses those the running DSH does not satisfy through `engines.dsh` — neither
of which means anything with a single version per plugin. The build therefore reads each
npm package's registry document and lists the versions that declare `dsh.bundle`, are not
deprecated,

plugins.description: Select text anywhere in a DSH conversation, attach a note to it, and send the whole annotation batch together with the next message.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-context-annotations

[![DSH Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4D6BFE)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%E2%89%A5%200.1.7--rc.2-4D6BFE)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE)

**English** · [中文](README.zh.md)

A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI plugin: select any text in the conversation,
write a note about it, and let the whole batch ride along with your next message
— for that one round only.

This repository carries the [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic, which the DeepSeek Harness documentation requires of plugin repositories so they can be discovered; the link above is the inline, clickable form of that requirement.

## What it does

1. **Select → annotate.** Select text anywhere in the conversation (a reply, a
   tool card, your own message), and a floating **注释** button appears beside the
   selection. Click it, type the note, press **Enter**. Shift+Enter breaks the
   line, Escape cancels.
2. **Collect several.** Every saved note becomes a numbered marker at the left
   edge of the passage it is about — **hovering a marker shows that note** — and a
   **N 条注释** strip appears above the composer. Click the strip to open the
   pending batch, where each annotation shows its quoted passage and note with
   edit and delete actions. Clicking a marker opens that note's editor, with a
   delete button.
3. **Send together.** Your message gains one short **“💬 N 条注释”** bubble; the
   annotation text never appears in the conversation. **Hover that bubble** to see
   exactly which passages the batch quoted and what each note says. The list
   reaches the model as a system-prompt section, so the request still carries
   every quoted passage and note. The batch is consumed once and its markers stay
   in the transcript, dimmed.
4. **Send alone.** With an empty composer, the strip's send button starts a round
   from the annotations alone.

## How it works

The browser half owns the editing UI; the Host half owns delivery.

- The browser posts the complete batch to `/api/dsh-context-annotations`
  (a route registered through `ctx.connection.fetch`, behind the carrier's trust
  fence). It never writes into the draft.
- The Host keeps that batch per Session and listens on the `agent/pre-step`
  waterfall. `pre-step` hands over exactly the messages the step claimed — never
  replayed history — so a batch can only ride one round. When the step carries a
  `source.kind === "user"` message, the Host appends one extra message that holds
  only the marker (`💬 N 条注释`) and leaves the human message byte-for-byte
  unchanged.
- The annotation text does not travel in a message: `ctx.systemPrompt.section()`
  contributes it to the prompt, and the rendered prompt is logged as a hidden
  `system/message` node. The conversation therefore shows one short bubble while
  the request carries the full list; both are reconstructable from the log, and
  no plugin event type is invented.
- The marker message is written before the step records its messages, so it is
  part of an ordinary `user/message` record, and the prompt is likewise
  reconstructable from the log. By design, fork, resume and replay should
  reproduce the conversation the model saw; no plugin event type is invented.
- An empty composer cannot submit on its own, so the strip's send button writes a
  zero-width draft; that round is one empty human message plus the marker.
- The batch outlives only the turn it rode: `pre-step` marks it consumed (the
  browser then clears the strip) and that turn's `turn/end` retires it from the
  prompt, so a later round never inherits it. A batch that no round consumed is
  left pending instead — a note written while the model is still answering waits
  for your next message rather than vanishing with that turn.
- After a send the browser reconciles with one cheap request: the Host states
  `consumed` explicitly, which marks the local annotations sent (the strip
  collapses and the markers stay, dimmed). The same request adopts a still-pending
  batch after a page reload.

## What the conversation shows vs what the model receives

The conversation gains exactly one short message:

```
💬 2 条注释
```

The model receives the list as a system-prompt section:

```
1. 所选文本：
<the selected passage>
注释：<your note>

2. 所选文本：
<the selected passage>
注释：<your note>
```

## Files

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | Host half: batch store, `/api/dsh-context-annotations`, `agent/pre-step` fold |
| `lib/client.js` | Browser half: selection button, note editor, numbered markers, composer strip and panel |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Insert the plugin row into the profile |
| `locale/{zh,en}.json` | Plugin Manager title and description |
| `test/smoke.mjs` | Dependency-free test of the fold semantics and the browser bundle's registration |
| `test/client.mjs` | Regression test for the browser store: per-Session push, explicit consumption, editor identity, composer exclusion |

## Configuration

The bundle currently reads no configuration. The folded list carries no marker
line, so it reads as the user's own numbered notes rather than a plugin block.

## Install

Installed from this repository:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle  target="github:YubaiLoving/dsh-context-annotations"
```

Or from a local checkout of this directory:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle  (target: this directory)
```

## Limits

- Markers key on character offsets into the flattened conversation text and are
  validated against the recorded passage; when that offset no longer matches (the
  content above the passage changed), a whitespace-insensitive passage search
  takes over, disambiguated by the passage's occurrence ordinal. There is no DOM
  path fallback. A passage that is re-rendered with different wording loses its
  marker; the note itself stays in the strip and is still sent. Markers that
  would land on the same box are nudged upwards so they do not stack.
- Annotations live in Host memory per Session. A Host restart drops a pending
  batch (the browser adopts only what the Host still holds).
- The float, strip, and panel read documented `data-*` markers of the shipped
  conversation shell (`[data-conversation-content]`, `[data-composer-seat]`,
  `[data-composer-card]`) and the browser's own selection. No other plugin's DOM
  is modified.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Cursor-like right sidebar for DeepSeek Harness: file tree, editor, Git, terminal, side chat and Ctrl+L references.
plugins.readme_text: # CursorLike Sidebar **让 DSH 对话与项目文件在同一工作区协作。** **Browse files, bring code into chat, and review agent edits inside DeepSeek Harness.** `dsh-cursorlike-sidebar` 是嵌入 DSH 原生右侧栏的工作区插件，提供文件浏览、代码编辑、Markdown 预览、Git 差异、原生终端、侧边对话与分屏，主题随 DSH 切换。 A workspace sidebar for DSH with a file browser, code editor, Markdown preview, Git diffs, native terminal, side chat, and split panes. It follows the DSH theme. 独立 DeepSeek Harness 插件，与 Cursor / Anysphere 无隶属关系。 An independent DeepSeek Harness plugin, unaffiliated with Cursor or Anysphere. [功能介绍 · Features](#features) · [安装 · Installation](#installation) · [快捷键 · Shortcuts](#shortcuts) · [更新日志](./CHANGELOG.md) · [Changelog](./CHANGELOG_EN.md) ![在 DSH 中选中 Markdown 文本，通过 Ctrl+L 添加带行号的会话引用 / Add selected Markdown text to chat with Ctrl+L](./docs/screenshots/chat-reference.png) *实际使用截图：左侧对话、右侧 Markdown 预览，选中文字后添加带行号的引用。 / In-app screenshot: chat beside a Markdown preview, with selected text referenced by line number.* ## 功能介绍 · Features ### 1. 按习惯浏览文件 · Browse your way 同一个工作区支持三种视图，可从文件面板工具栏切换： - **桌面图标网格 / Icon grid**：默认视图，三列排列，首格返回上级。单击文件夹进入、单击文件打开，适合直观浏览。 - **树形列表 / File tree**：展开目录层级，查看项目结构，适合定位源码。 - **Miller 多列 / Miller columns**：逐级目录并排展开，适合在深层路径间浏览。 Switch between a default icon grid, a hierarchical file tree, and Miller columns without leaving the workspace. **桌面图标网格 / Icon grid** ![桌面图标网格 / Icon grid](./docs/screenshots/file-view-1.png) **树形列表 / File tree** ![树形列表 / File tree](./docs/screenshots/file-view-3.png) **Miller 多列 / Miller columns** ![Miller 多列 / Miller columns](./docs/screenshots/file-view-2.png) 右键可打开文件、新建 Tab、侧边打开、添加引用或复制路径。支持文件多选、复制/剪切/粘贴、重命名、删除及文件操作历史。网格中按住 `Ctrl` 滚轮可调整图标大小（24–160px），64px 以上的图片图标显示缩略图；树形视图支持 10–32px 图标缩放。 Use context menus and multi-selection to manage files, with clipboard operations and file operation history. Ctrl + mouse wheel adjusts icon size, with image thumbnails in larger grid sizes. ### 2. 把文件和选区带入对话 · Bring context into chat 选中文件或代码后按 **`Ctrl+L`**，即可把相关上下文添加到当前对话，减少复制路径、粘贴代码的步骤。 - 文件浏览器：选中文件后添加文件引用。 - 代码编辑器：选中代码后添加行范围；没有选区时添加当前行。 - Markdown 预览：选中文字后映射到源码行号，支持正文中的粗体、列表、行内代码。 - 拖放：将文件引用或选中代码拖入聊天输入区，也可把文件引用拖到文件面板打开。 Press **Ctrl+L** on a selected file, code selection, or Markdown preview text. References use a native `@file` chip with a line suffix such as `line 12-18`. With no editor selection, the current line is referenced. Drag files or selected code into chat for the same workflow. 引用格式示例：`@src/app.ts line 12-18`。Markdown 预览无法唯一定位源码时，会退化为文件引用并附上选中文字，保留必要上下文。 If a Markdown selection cannot be mapped uniquely to source lines, the reference includes the selected text as a fallback. ### 3. 隐藏无关文件 · Keep the file browser focused 在**工作区根目录**创建 `.ignore`，隐藏依赖、构建产物或日志。也可把文件或文件夹拖到工具栏的 **`.ignore` 眼睛图标**，自动追加规则并刷新。 Create a root-level `.ignore` to hide distracting files, or drag a file or folder onto the ignore icon to append a rule and refresh the browser. ```gitignore node_modules .cache *.log ``` ![在编辑器中配置工作区根目录 .ignore / Root-level .ignore configuration](./docs/screenshots/ignore-files.png) 规则使用 gitignore 风格的 glob，当前仅读取根目录 `.ignore`，不支持 `!` 反向选择。手动编辑后点击刷新。隐藏仅影响文件展示，不会删除文件，也不会释放磁盘空间。 Rules use gitignore-style globs. Only the workspace root file is read, and `!` negation is unsupported. Refresh after manual edits. Hiding files affects display only and does not delete them. ### 4. 逐块审查 Agent 修改 · Review agent edits by hunk ![轮次改动审阅：默认单栏、按块同意/不同意、上下跳转与撤销 / Turn review in unified view with per-block accept/reject, change navigation, and undo](./docs/screenshots/diff-round-review-unified.png) *实际使用截图：原生「第 N 轮改动」页按块审阅。工具栏显示「第 N/M 处修改 · 还剩 K 处」，提供 ↑ / ↓ 跳转、同意 / 不同意、全部同意 / 全部不同意和撤销操作（做出决定后可用）。 / In-app screenshot: block review on the native turn page — position, previous/next, accept/reject, bulk actions, and undo (enabled after a decision).* 原生「第 N 轮改动」页**默认单栏对比**，可手动切换左右分栏。连续改动行合并为一个更改块，每块只显示一组**同意 / 不同意**，也可**全部同意 / 全部不同意**。使用 **↑ / ↓** 跳到上一处或下一处，支持 Tab 聚焦按钮和恢复已保存的审阅决定。**Ctrl+K 同意、Ctrl+J 不同意、Ctrl+Z 撤销上一步**，快捷键直接显示在独立审阅工具栏中。待处理内容以红绿对比显示；同意后恢复普通背景、保留新内容并隐藏旧行，Ctrl+Z 后重新显示原始对比。撤销栈保存在本地，宿主重新挂载或刷新页面后仍可撤销上一步。窄面板中操作按钮移到块下方，避免挤压文字。 The native turn review opens in unified view, with split view available on demand. Consecutive changed lines form one block. Accepting a block shows ordinary file content and hides the removed side; Ctrl+Z restores its original comparison. The toolbar shows the current position, previous/next navigation, individual and bulk decisions, and undo; Ctrl+K accepts, Ctrl+J rejects, and Ctrl+Z undoes the last decision. Undo history survives host remounts and page refreshes. Narrow panes place block actions below the text. 手动切换左右分栏后，同一组块操作仍然可用： ![左右分栏改动审阅 / Split-view turn review](./docs/screenshots/diff-round-review.png) *左右分栏对比（手动切换）。 / Side-by-side comparison (manual switch).* Agent 修改当前打开的文件后，编辑器直接显示内联差异：新增或改写行标绿，旧内容以红色删除块显示。按改动块（hunk）逐个**保留 / Keep** 或**撤销 / Revert**，处理后自动跳到下一处，操作条显示进度，也可一次处理全部修改。 The editor highlights agent edits inline, with green additions and red deleted content. Keep or revert individual hunks, move automatically to the next change, or handle all changes at once. 「更改」页按连续更改块审查本轮 write/edit 操作：每块提供保留 / 撤销，处理后跳到下一处，一个文件处理完后切到下一个改动文件。只有能重建完整旧内容、且磁盘仍匹配该操作结果时才启用写回；否则显示只读 diff 与原因。**拒绝改动会立即写回磁盘。** The Changes tab groups consecutive changed lines into one review block. Keep or reject a block, move to the next change, and advance to the next file when finished. Ctrl+K accepts, Ctrl+J rejects, and Ctrl+Z undoes the last decision. Review requires a complete previous version and a matching current file; otherwise it stays read-only with an explanation. **Rejecting a change writes to disk immediately.** 未处理的编辑器审查状态按会话与文件保存在本地。重启后，文件仍匹配待审版本时恢复；处理完毕后清除。 Pending editor reviews are saved locally per session and file, and restored after restart when the file still matches the pending version. ### 5. 编辑、终端与分屏 · Edit, run, and compare 代码编辑、Markdown 预览、搜索、Git 差异、原生终端与侧边对话都可在 DSH 中使用。分屏便于并排查看文件和操作结果，减少在外部窗口间切换。 Use editing, previews, search, Git diffs, a native terminal, and side chat inside DSH. Split panes help keep files and results visible together. 安装 `dsh-diff-approval` 时，本插件还提供原生右侧栏 dock 集成与 Keep/Revert 快捷键转发。首次将其旧浮层迁到 dock 后，会保留用户显式改回 float 的选择。 Optional `dsh-diff-approval` integration docks its review panel in the native sidebar and forwards Keep/Revert shortcuts, while respecting a later explicit switch back to floating mode. ## 常用快捷键 · Shortcuts 快捷键随焦点生效：文件操作、文本编辑和 Diff 审查各自使用对应上下文。 Shortcuts act on the focused browser, editor, or review surface. - **`Ctrl+L`**：文件、选区或当前行添加到会话 / Add file, selection, or current line to chat. - **`Ctrl+C` / `Ctrl+X` / `Ctrl+V`**：文件浏览器中复制、剪切、粘贴 / Copy, cut, and paste files in the browser. - **`Ctrl+Z`**：撤销当前上下文中的操作；审查时撤销上一步决定 / Undo in the active context, including the last review decision. - **`Ctrl+Shift+Z` / `Ctrl+Y`**：文件浏览器中重做 / Redo file browser operations. - **`F5`**：刷新文件浏览器 / Refresh the file browser. - **`Ctrl+K` / `Ctrl+J`**：同意 / 不同意当前改动块（编辑器、「更改」页、官方轮次审阅）/ Accept or reject the active block (editor, Changes tab, turn review). - **`Ctrl+Alt+K` / `Ctrl+Alt+J`**：全部同意 / 全部不同意当前审阅 / Accept or reject every remaining block in the active review. - **`Ctrl+滚轮 / mouse wheel`**：调整文件图标大小 / Resize file icons. 保留 DSH 原有 `Ctrl+B` 行为，无需额外桌面软件或 Python 运行时，不包含 PDF 依赖。 The plugin preserves DSH's existing Ctrl+B behavior and requires no additional desktop app or Python runtime. It does not bundle PDF dependencies. ## 安装 · Installation 适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 及兼容版本。安装前停用原版 `dsh-better-sidebar`，安装或更新后完全退出并重启 DSH。 Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 or a compatible version. plugins.description: MT 管理器 MCP 连接 DeepSeek Harness 插件：在 Web 设置页填 MT 的 MCP 地址，手机文件/APK/ZIP 能力以 mcp__mt__* 工具可用。Connect MT Manager (Android) to DeepSeek Harness as a DSH plugin.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mt-mcp [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered_by-dsh-4D6BFE?style=flat-square&logo=deepseek&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) ![DSH plugin 0.1.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH_plugin-0.1.0-4D6BFE?style=flat-square&logo=deepseek&logoColor=white) ![MCP Streamable HTTP](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-Streamable_HTTP-blueviolet?style=flat-square) ![deps 0](https://img.shields.io/badge/deps-0-brightgreen?style=flat-square) ![MT Manager Android](https://img.shields.io/badge/MT_Manager-Android-3DDC84?style=flat-square&logo=android&logoColor=white) ![license MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green?style=flat-square) 连接手机上的 **MT 管理器**（[mt.cc](https://mt.cc)）与 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）** · Connect **MT Manager** ([mt.cc](https://mt.cc)) on your Android phone to **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**. > 本页默认显示**简体中文**。英文版在下方折叠区，点开即在当前页面展开，不会跳转。 > > This page shows **简体中文** by default. The English version is collapsed below — expand it in place, without leaving this page.
English version（点击展开 / click to expand）
Connect **MT Manager** ([mt.cc](https://mt.cc)) on your Android phone to **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**. MT Manager ships an MCP server: start it on the phone and it becomes a **Streamable HTTP** MCP endpoint exposing phone files, APK, and ZIP capabilities. This plugin is the **desktop-side client** — a DSH plugin bundle that brings MT's tools into DSH sessions and adds a settings panel where the address can be changed at any time. Once connected, MT's capabilities appear as `mcp__mt__*` tools, so you can just ask in plain language: ``` Read test.txt in MT's Home folder and summarize it. Don't modify anything yet. Analyze the startup flow of the current APK and explain the relevant classes and methods. Pack the project folder in Home into project.zip at the archive root. ``` ### Why this exists DSH's built-in MCP client (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`) is configured through the composition: changing the endpoint means editing a profile patch file and restarting the Host. But a phone's LAN IP **changes** — DHCP lease renewal, a different Wi-Fi, a hotspot. This plugin moves "where to connect" out of configuration files and into the Web settings page: type the address, save, and it reconnects. No restart, no YAML. ### Install Requires a working DSH (`dsh web` opens the UI). **Compatible with DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` and later** (`0.2.x`). The plugin has **no runtime third-party dependencies**: the MCP protocol is implemented in `lib/mcp-http.js` using Node's built-in `fetch`, and the only import is DSH's own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`. Any install method works, and `pnpm install` is never needed. #### One-line install (recommended) ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:aikunx/dsh-mt-mcp ``` Then **refresh the Web page once** — a newly installed client plugin has to be reloaded. "MT Manager" then appears in the settings sidebar. > Using a different profile? Replace `web`. The Electron-managed `desktop` profile is handled by the app itself and does not go through this command. > > `dsh plugin` forwards its arguments to pnpm verbatim, so any pnpm-supported spec works. To pin a commit: > `dsh plugin --profile web add github:aikunx/dsh-mt-mcp#` #### Install from the plugin market Add this index URL to the Plugins settings page, then install from the Discover tab: ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aikunx/dsh-mt-mcp/main/market.json ``` #### Local development ```bash git clone https://github.com/aikunx/dsh-mt-mcp.git cd dsh-mt-mcp dsh plugin --profile web add . ``` No dependency install needed. Alternatively, have the Agent driving your session call `plugin_manager(action: "install_bundle", target: "")`. > If the plugin row reports `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` with a path pointing at a **previous** install location, the Host process cached the old module resolution — restart DSH. ### The panel ![The "MT Manager" panel in DSH settings](docs/settings-panel.png) Settings → MT Manager: enter the address and an optional token, then save to connect. The panel lists discovered tools and shows the config file path. > The image is drawn from the panel source's layout and sizing, to convey the information structure. Actual appearance follows your DSH theme (light/dark). ### Usage 1. On the phone: MT Manager → **sidebar → Tools → MCP Service → Start**. 2. Copy the address MT shows. DSH runs on your computer, so use the **LAN address**, e.g. `http://192.168.5.20:8787/mcp`. - The trailing `/mcp` is required; the default port is `8787`. - **Do not use `127.0.0.1`** — that points at the computer itself, not the phone. 3. In DSH: **Settings → MT Manager**, paste the address, then "Save and connect". 4. A green status line means connected, and the panel lists the discovered tools (measured: MT 2.26.x exposes **57**). #### The address changes; edit it any time Edit the address in the panel and save — **no DSH restart needed**. It reconnects immediately and replaces both the old connection and the registered tools. Set a **static IP / DHCP reservation** for the phone on your router to avoid editing it at all. #### Bearer token (optional) MT has authentication **off** by default: anyone who can reach the port can call it. Enable Bearer token auth under MT's **Settings → Authentication**, then paste the token into the panel's token field: - The token is created by MT; it is unrelated to any model API key. - Leaving the field empty keeps the current token; only "Clear token" removes it. - It is echoed only as `abcd****wxyz` — the full token never appears in any output. - Authentication does **not** encrypt HTTP. Use it on a trusted LAN only, and **never expose port 8787 to the internet**. ### What it can do The tools come from MT; this plugin only forwards them. Three groups by name: | Prefix | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `mcp__mt__mt_file_*` | Phone files: list directories, search by name/content/size/time, read and write text and bytes, move and delete, create directories | | `mcp__mt__mt_apk_*` | APK: open a workspace, analyze manifest/resources/smali/so, edit, rebuild and sign, manage workspaces | | `mcp__mt__mt_zip_*` | ZIP: browse, read entries, verify integrity, create, add/replace/delete entries, extract | Plus two helper tools from this plugin: | Tool | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `mt_mcp_status` | Show address, connection state, tool count, last error (never echoes the token) | | `mt_mcp_connect` | Reconnect using the saved address | #### The phone decides the access scope Which files are reachable is **entirely decided by MT's file access rules**; this plugin offers no bypass. The measured default is "the Home folder is read-write, everything else is denied": - Home defaults to `/storage/emulated/0/MT2/mcp` (changeable in MT's **Settings → General**). - To read outside Home, add a rule for that directory in MT's **Settings → Files**. - Files inside Home **cannot** be tightened to read-only; put files needing read-only protection outside Home and grant them individually. Only you can change these rules, on the phone. ### Disconnects and reconnects - On disconnect it retries with **1s → 2s → 4s … 30s** backoff, up to 10 attempts. After that, press "Reconnect" in the panel. - Android may kill MT in the background. Enable **floating ball** in MT's **Settings → General** and grant the overlay permission; this markedly improves survival. - Restarting MT's service or the phone changing IP will drop the connection. Edit the address and save, or press "Reconnect". - Phone and computer must be on the **same LAN**. Guest Wi-Fi, AP isolation, and VPNs can all prevent connection. ### Security boundary | Item | Detail | | --- | --- | | Config storage | `~/.dsh/dsh-mt-mcp.json`, mode `0600` | | Settings routes | `/api/dsh-mt-mcp/*` accepts **loopback requests only** (verified via source IP, Host header, Origin), so nobody else on the LAN can change your config | | Token echo | Always masked; the full token exists only in the config file above | | Transport encryption | **None**. MT's MCP service is plain HTTP; trusted

plugins.description: DSH 插件：web_focus 工具按关键词对抓取页面做相关度筛选，压缩链接、过滤导航、保留可回取的原文并缓存，让 web_fetch 不再一次性消耗大量token。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-web-focus

Focused reading for [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DeepSeek Harness):
`web_focus` fetches one URL and injects **the sentences that answer a focus you
write**, instead of the whole page.

The built-in `web_fetch` injects a page's markdown as-is (up to the host's
output cap). This plugin registers a separate tool, `web_focus`, that ranks
sentences by token overlap with `focus`, guarantees coverage of rare query terms,
drops navigation chrome and compresses links, keeps the uncompressed original on
disk, and labels exactly how much was omitted.

**0.2.0 registers no fetch provider.** `web_fetch` keeps its stock behaviour; the
plugin reaches the network only through the public `ctx.web.fetch()` API. There is
no `fetchProvider` patch and disabling the bundle cannot break `web_fetch`.

## What changed in 0.2.2 (2026-10-18)

- A focused digest admits only headings that contain a focus term (at most 8);
  unmatched headings are skipped by both the forced set and the score fill. The
  zero-match fallback still returns the page outline. On the San Francisco check
  this removed the 19 heading lines; the digest is now 17 non-omitted lines with
  0 headings (2 navigation links and 4 citation/footer lines remain).
- `SANITIZE_CALL_SITES` points at `assemble.js`'s `compressStage`; the stale
  `provider.js` reference is removed.

## What changed in 0.2.1 (2026-10-18)

- Every content-bearing focus term now keeps its best sentence, not only terms
  below a rarity threshold. `population` no longer loses to rarer words.
- The strongest query-bearing body sentences are protected from coverage and
  reconciliation, and long pages force at most 20 headings (0.2.2 narrows this to
  focus-matched headings).
- `founding` / `foundation` now trigger the founding-date pass alongside
  `founded` / `established` / `incorporated`.
- The live-page check below states the exact focus used.

## What changed in 0.2.0 (2026-10-18)

The unreleased 0.1.0 prototype took over the fetch path and, when a digest
retained under 40% of a page's sentences, **injected the whole compressed page
instead**. A controlled benchmark (below) measured what that did:

| Page size | 0.1.0: injected | 0.2.x: injected | 0.1.0: key sentences kept | 0.2.x |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10k chars | 6.9k | 2.9k | 76% | **100%** |
| 25k | 15.5k | 2.4k | 94% | **100%** |
| 50k | 62k (full text) | 4.0k | 100% (by accident) | **100%** |
| 100k | 79.8k (capped full text) | 4.3k | 61% | **100%** |
| 200k | 79.8k (capped full text) | 4.4k | 56% | **100%** |
| no matching content | 30k / 80k | 644 / 1.7k | — | — |

Live-page checks, same code path (measured during development):

- `en.wikipedia.org/wiki/San_Francisco`: 459,687 raw chars → 3,765 body chars
  (0.8% of the raw page) with focus `population mayor mission founding date`.
  Population `873,965`, mayor `Daniel Lurie`, and `June 29, 1776` are all
  present. The old full-text fallback produced 79.8k chars on this page.
- `zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/Xiamen`: 335,038 raw chars → 3,946 body chars (1.2% of
  the raw page). The Siming district and Hubin North Road 61 are present.

Four changes produced that:

1. **Query-term coverage.** Every content-bearing focus term keeps its
   best-scoring sentence, not only terms that pass a rarity threshold; rare
   terms keep every occurrence or their two best sentences. Coverage runs after
   the score fill and may displace ordinary filler, never a protected answer.
   Two role/date fact passes cover shapes that share no query token: a
   `| Mayor | Daniel Lurie |` row (role + person) and a `| Mission | June 29,
   1776 |` row (earliest dated founding/incorporation row). The date pass
   recognises `founded`, `founding`, `foundation`, `established` and
   `incorporated`.
2. **Sparse digest instead of the full-text breaker.** A low retention ratio now
   yields a small digest plus an explicit `⚠️ [digest: sparse match …]` note.
   `full=true` (or the retained raw text) remains the way to read everything.
   Zero-match pages now return headings and first/last sentences — not 80k chars
   of unrelated text.
3. **Focus-sized adaptive budget.** The legacy `clamp(50%, 4k, 24k)` page budget
   was replaced by a cap that scales with the number of content-bearing focus
   tokens (4k–12k), and sentences below 22% of the best selected score are dropped
   unless forced, block-cohesive, or coverage-protected. Whole low-score blocks are
   dropped together, so list items stay whole.
4. **Answer protection and a heading cap.** The top query-bearing body sentences
   are protected from coverage and reconciliation, and only headings that contain
   a focus term can enter the digest (at most 8); unmatched headings are skipped
   by both the forced set and score fill. This keeps a multi-attribute answer in
   the digest and stops a table of contents from consuming the budget.

Two measured selection bugs were also fixed: the budget-reconciliation pass used
to sacrifice a rank-2 answer sentence (score 44.7) to keep low-score "sticky"
filler, and the score fill could exceed the budget because coverage additions were
not counted. MediaWiki Parsoid JSON (the infobox template leaked as one 18.6k
line on the San Francisco page) is dropped, and markdown table rows are preserved
instead of being mistaken for menu lines.

## How selection works

```
raw text → strip invisible chars → compress links / drop nav → split sentences
        → forced: first 2 + last 2 + query-matched headings (at most 8)
        → score fill: focus-sized budget 4k–12k
        → protect the top query-bearing answer sentences
        → query-term/role/date coverage (displaces ordinary filler)
        → block cohesion (groups of ≤4 sentences)
        → adaptive trim (<22% of best score)
        → budget reconciliation (answers and forced sentences survive)
        → coverage header + sparse-match note
```

Scoring is in-page IDF × query-token overlap, plus small priors for position,
numbers and headings. `focus` is a **keyword query**, not a summarization
instruction: write the words you expect the answer to contain.

## Known boundary: paraphrase

Token-overlap selection cannot find a fact that shares **no vocabulary** with the
focus. The benchmark's paraphrase case (page says "closed a $42 million financing
round", focus says "how much outside money did it take") keeps 2 of 3 key
sentences; the missing one has a score of 0.8 (numeric prior only). This is a
limitation of lexical retrieval, not a tuning bug. Mitigations: write the focus
with likely page vocabulary, use `full=true` for paraphrase-heavy pages, or read
the retained raw text. The other adversarial cases — multi-sentence answers,
tables, Chinese pages, a rare term appearing in seven sentences, a key past the
80k cap — all keep 100% of key sentences.

## Requirements

- DSH with the built-in `web` service (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`).
- Node.js ≥ 18.
- `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` (peer dependency; DSH provides it).

### Host fetch cap (important on long pages)

The host's http fetcher truncates decoded bodies at **100,000 chars** by default.
On a large Wikipedia page that cut lands inside the infobox, before the prose:
the plugin receives navigation only, compresses it under the 8k selection
trigger, and cannot select what never arrived. The plugin now warns explicitly
when `truncated: true`, but the real fix is the host row:

```yaml
- id: web-fetch-http
  config:
    maxBodyChars: 2000000
```

That is the value used by the profile this was tested with (2M = the plugin's own
HTML input cap, so the host is no longer the limiting factor). It requires a host
restart. `maxTextLength` (80k) remains the separate context-budget knob.

## Install

The package is not published to npm. Clone this repository and install the
bundle from the checkout:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/shutongcao1-design/dsh_WebFocus.git
```

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle   target: <absolute path to the checkout>
```

The bundle patch only inserts the plugin row; it does **not** touch the `web`
row. If an older provider-based copy is installed, remove that bundle first and
update a

plugins.description: 告别繁琐的手动配置！本插件支持从 Claude Desktop、Cursor、VS Code、YAML 或网页中直接导入 MCP 配置。在写入前，它会自动帮你进行安全审查和风险提示，只需点一下确认，就能把第三方工具无缝接入 DSH，您可从「设置 → MCP 安装」中管理相应信息。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH MCP Installer

在 DSH「设置 → MCP 安装」中导入并管理 MCP 服务器，配置写入当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`。

## 快速开始
请注意：建议用户安装v1.1.1及以上版本，此版本带来了相关的错误修复。

检查 npm 上当前发布版本：

```bash
npm view dsh-mcp-installer version
```

普通 DSH CLI 用户可安装到 `web` profile：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mcp-installer
```
指定版本
```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mcp-installer@1.1.1
```
安装最新版本
```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mcp-installer@latest
```

将 `web` 替换为你实际使用的非 Desktop profile。安装后打开或重启该 profile，在 **设置 → MCP 安装** 中使用。

DSH Desktop 的 `desktop` profile 由 Desktop 自带的 DSH 命令管理。先启动 Desktop 初始化 profile，再在 Desktop 提供的命令环境中运行：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-mcp-installer
```

不要用单独安装的通用 `dsh` CLI 管理 Desktop 的保留 profile。

## 使用 MCP 安装器

打开 DSH **设置 → MCP 安装**。页面顶部会显示当前 profile 的目标配置文件和可写状态。

### 查看已安装服务器

「已安装」页展示当前 DSH Loader 中生效的 MCP 服务器，包括来源层、传输方式、连接状态和工具数。可按名称、命令或 URL 搜索；点击一行可展开详情。刷新可重新读取实时状态。

![已安装的 MCP 服务器列表](docs/images/mcp-installed.png)

### 添加服务器

1. 选择 **安装新服务器**。
2. 粘贴 MCP 配置，或选择 `.json`、`.yaml`、`.yml`、`.toml`、`.md`、`.markdown`、`.txt` 文件。也可输入文档或配置网页链接并选择 **读取并解析**。
3. 选择 **解析文本**（链接导入会自动解析），检查每个服务器的传输方式、命令或 URL 和安全风险；按需确认风险提示，并选择要安装的服务器。
4. 选择 **安装所选服务器**。配置写入当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`；完成后回到「已安装」查看运行状态。新会话或重启后生效；启用 HMR 时会自动重载。

![粘贴、导入文件或从链接读取 MCP 配置](docs/images/mcp-import.png)

支持 `mcpServers`（Claude Desktop / Claude Code / Cursor）、`servers`（VS Code）、`[mcp_servers.<name>]`（Codex）、普通 YAML 和 Markdown 代码块，也支持 Claude/Codex CLI 命令。支持 `stdio` 与 `streamable-http`，不支持 SSE。

编辑或删除仅适用于当前 profile patch 中可唯一定位的服务器。来自 home patch、bundle 等其他来源的服务器需在所属配置层管理。

示例：

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "filesystem": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "."]
    }
  }
}
```

## 安全说明

- 导入的 env/header 值会写入 profile patch；敏感值建议使用 DSH 支持的 `!!js` 环境变量表达式。页面只显示键名，编辑时保留原值。
- 高风险命令或 URL 需要确认；网页导入会拒绝本机和内网地址。

## 开发

```bash
npm install
npm run build
npm run typecheck
npm test
```

# dsh-plugin-mobile-ui

> **Язык / Language:** [Русский](#dsh-plugin-mobile-ui-ru) · [English](#dsh-plugin-mobile-ui-en)


Плагин мобильного интерфейса для DeepSeek Harness. Встраивается в ваш локальный DSH, автоматически запускает веб-сервер и туннель ngrok и поддерживает React PWA, так что вы можете управлять DSH со своего телефона в любой сети — без домена, без VPS, с возможностью установки на домашний экран, с авторизацией и потоковой передачей через WebSocket.


Mobile UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Embeds into your local DSH, auto-starts a web server and ngrok tunnel, and serves a React PWA so you can control DSH from your phone on any network — no domain, no VPS, installable to home screen, with auth and WebSocket streaming

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

---

## dsh-plugin-mobile-ui-ru

> [English version below ↓](#dsh-plugin-mobile-ui-en)

Самодостаточный мобильный доступ к DeepSeek Harness. Одна установка даёт:

- **защищённую паролем публичную ссылку** (ngrok, с запасным вариантом через Cloudflare Tunnel);
- **официальный веб-интерфейс DeepSeek Harness**, отдаваемый по этой ссылке;
- **адаптированный под телефон слой** поверх этого интерфейса.

Без домена, без VPS и без дополнительных плагинов — туннель, вход по паролю и мобильный слой вшиты внутрь пакета.

### Содержание

- [Что это делает](#что-это-делает)
- [Возможности](#возможности)
- [Требования](#требования)
- [Быстрый старт](#быстрый-старт)
- [Установка](#установка)
- [Настройка](#настройка)
- [Использование](#использование)
- [Примеры](#примеры)
- [Решение проблем](#решение-проблем)
- [Обновление и удаление](#обновление-и-удаление)
- [Безопасность](#безопасность)
- [FAQ](#faq)
- [Совместимость и ограничения](#совместимость-и-ограничения)
- [Лицензия](#лицензия)
- [Благодарности](#благодарности)

### Что это делает

DeepSeek Harness работает локально на вашем компьютере. Плагин открывает его веб-интерфейс для телефона и делает этот интерфейс удобным на маленьком сенсорном экране.

После установки вы открываете локальный веб-интерфейс, вставляете один токен, задаёте пароль — и получаете публичную HTTPS-ссылку и QR-код. Сканируете код на телефоне — открывается DeepSeek Harness, один раз спрашивается пароль, и дальше вы управляете локальным DSH из любой сети.

Три части поставляются вместе:

- **`dsh-plugin-mobile-ui/relay`** — вход по паролю и TLS перед петлевым веб-сервером.
- **`dsh-plugin-mobile-ui/tunnel`** — публикует relay через ngrok (или Cloudflare Tunnel).
- **`dsh-plugin-mobile-ui`** — мобильный слой поверх официального веб-интерфейса.

### Возможности

- **Публичный доступ без инфраструктуры.** Публичная HTTPS-ссылка создаётся автоматически, без домена и VPS.
- **Защита паролем.** Всё, что за ссылкой, требует заданный вами пароль (минимум 10 символов).
- **Подключение телефона по QR-коду.** Одноразовый 8-значный код (и QR, в который он зашит) подключает телефон; код действует сутки, а QR ведёт на публичный адрес ngrok.
- **Мобильный веб-интерфейс.** На узких экранах слой добавляет:
  - выдвижную панель со списком чатов, открываемую кнопкой в шапке;
  - кнопку «новый чат» в шапке;
  - живой бейдж статуса и полосу статистики, закреплённую сверху;
  - индикатор загрузки при переключении чата;
  - кнопку «вниз, к последнему сообщению», закреплённую над полем ввода;
  - обработку клавиатуры/видимой области и standalone-манифест PWA с иконками.
- **Без влияния на десктоп.** Мобильный слой включается только на узких экранах (≤1023 px); десктоп остаётся штатным.
- **Всё настраивается из интерфейса.** Токены ngrok, публичная ссылка, код подключения и пароль задаются в настройках, а не правкой файлов.
- **Несколько ngrok-аккаунтов.** Токены добавляются строками с именами: плагин помнит активный и сам переключается на следующий, когда у текущего кончается месячный трафик (`ERR_NGROK_725`). Переключить можно и вручную — тапом по строке в «Ссылки по аккаунтам»; активная строка обведена зелёным.
- **Счётчик трафика.** Расход виден полосой под логотипом в меню (зелёная → оранжевая → красная) и карточкой «Трафик ngrok» в настройках. Значение можно поправить вручную по кабинету ngrok — счётчик продолжит расти от него.
- **Меньше трафика.** Ассеты кэшируются `immutable`, relay пережимает их brotli (−15% к gzip), а service worker держит оболочку и ассеты в своём хранилище: повторный вход стоит около 7 КБ вместо 350.
- **Подсказка про VPN.** Если интерфейс не догрузился за 12 секунд или сетевой запрос упал, появляется объяснение: из РФ DeepSeek доступен только через VPN.
- **Раздел Mobile UI идёт первым** в навигации настроек.

### Требования

| Требование | Для чего | Примечания |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | Для всего | Должен быть установлен и запущен (`dsh web`). |
| Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24` | Плагин | Указано в `engines` пакета. |
| `ngrok` бесплатный authtoken | Туннели ngrok | Туннель создает публичну ссылку. |
| Бинарник `cloudflared` | Туннели Cloudflare | Аккаунт не нужен; используется при `DSH_TUNNEL_PROVIDER=cloudflared`. |
| `pnpm` | Установка из CLI | `dsh plugin` передаёт управление пакетами в pnpm. |

Бинарник туннеля (`ngrok` или `cloudflared`) **обязателен** для публичного доступа. Положите его в `PATH` или в `~/.dsh/bin/` (на Windows, например, `~/.dsh/bin/ngrok.exe`).

### Быстрый старт

1. Установите плагин (см. [Установка](#установка)):

   ```bash
   dsh plugin --profile web add github:dexwebcode/dsh-plugin-mobile-ui
   ```

2. Запустите DeepSeek Harness:

   ```bash
   dsh web
   ```

3. Откройте локальный веб-интерфейс и перейдите в **Настройки → Mobile UI**.

4. Вставьте authtoken ngrok в поле **Токен ngrok** и нажмите **Сохранить**. Токен бесплатный, берётся в [кабинете ngrok](https://dashboard.ngrok.com/get-started/your-authtoken). Аккаунтов можно добавить несколько: слева имя, справа токен, кнопка **+ Добавить токен** добавляет строку.

5. Подождите несколько секунд, пока в карточке **Туннель** не появится публичная ссылка (она появляется после подъёма туннеля).

6. В карточке **Пароль для входа** задайте пароль (не короче 10 символов). Сделайте это до того, как поделитесь ссылкой.

7. На телефоне отсканируйте QR из карточки **Подключение телефона** — или откройте публичную ссылку и введите показанный на экране код.

Мобильный доступ готов. Добавьте публичную ссылку в закладки: cookie входа живёт 30 дней.

> [!TIP]
> Если ngrok недоступен (например, блокировка `ERR_NGROK_9040`), переключитесь на Cloudflare: задайте `DSH_TUNNEL_PROVIDER=cloudflared` в окружении перед запуском DSH и убедитесь, что `cloudflared` есть в `PATH`.

### Установка

Плагин устанавливается в **профиль** DeepSeek Harness. Используйте любой из способов ниже.

#### Вариант A — из npm (одна команда, для Plugin Hub)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-mobile-ui
```

#### Вариант B — из GitHub

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:dexwebcode/dsh-plugin-mobile-ui
```

В репозитории уже лежит собранный вывод (`lib/` и `vendor/relay.js`), поэтому установка из git работает сразу.

#### Вариант C — из локальной сборки

```bash
# в клонированном репозитории
npm run build      # или: npm pack  (pack запускает build через prepack)
npm pack
```

Получится `dsh-plugin-mobile-ui-<версия>.tgz`. Установите его с полным путём:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "C:\путь\к\dsh-plugin-mobile-ui-3.6.0.tgz"
```

#### Вариант D — менеджер плагинов в веб-интерфейсе

Откройте DeepSeek Harness, перейдите в **Настройки → Плагины** и добавьте плагин там (репозиторий GitHub или собранный tarball).

> [!NOTE]
> `dsh plugin …` — менеджер пакетов профилей DeepSeek Harness; он передаёт команды в `pnpm` в каталоге активного профиля, поэтому `pnpm` должен быть в `PATH`.

#### Проверка установки

После установки и запуска `dsh web` откройте **Настройки**. Должен появиться раздел **Mobile UI** — он стоит первым в списке. Если раздела нет — плагин не загрузился в запущенный профиль: проверьте имя профиля и менеджер плагинов.

### Настройка

Все повседневные настройки находятся в **Настройки → Mobile UI**. Конфигурация не правится вручную в файлах; два файла состояния ниже плагин пишет сам.

| Параметр | Описание | По умолчанию | Обязателе
